lineage.purpose: Connect existing local atomic consumers to FLRW photon transport and distinguish mass inventory from geometric filling.

scope.spacetime: FLRW with common a(t) and H(t), proper time t
scope.matter: pure H, conserved H nuclei, same peculiar bulk velocity for HI and HII; explicit extensions required for He, diffusion or selected-gas sources
scope.radiation: spectral photon-number moments in FLRW observer frame, nonrelativistic gas transport; peculiar Doppler collision corrections excluded
scope.averages: fixed comoving domain and fixed comoving cell-volume weights
scope.moving_domain_rule: Add Reynolds boundary/weight terms before applying time-derivative and averaging commutation.

notation.nH: proper H nuclei number density, cm^-3
notation.ne: electron density; nH*x only under pure-H closure
notation.Gamma: photoionization rate per neutral H, s^-1
notation.alpha: explicitly owned Case-A or Case-B recombination coefficient, cm^3 s^-1
notation.kci: optional collisional ionization coefficient, cm^3 s^-1
notation.nnu: proper photon number per proper cm^3 per proper Hz
notation.Nnu: a^3*nnu; photons per reference comoving cm^3 per proper Hz
notation.Nq: a^2*nnu(q/a); photons per reference comoving cm^3 per comoving frequency q
notation.nu0: fixed proper H ionization threshold frequency
notation.B: mean(a^3*nH); H nuclei per reference comoving cm^3
notation.P: mean(a^3*np); ionized H per reference comoving cm^3
notation.G: mean(integral_nu0_infinity Nnu dnu); tracked ionizing photons per reference comoving cm^3
notation.QV: mean(b); geometric phase volume fraction requiring external b in {0,1}
notation.eta: G/B; tracked ionizing photons per H nucleus
notation.AH: mean(a^3*nHI*Gamma); matched H photoabsorption event rate
notation.Sstar: tracked primary photon production rate per reference comoving volume
notation.Jrec: tracked recombination ionizing photon production rate per reference comoving volume
notation.Aother: tracked photon sinks that do not create HII, e.g. He/dust
notation.BH: a^2/V times surface integral nH*v dot dA, outward positive
notation.Bp: a^2/V times surface integral np*v dot dA, outward positive
notation.Bgamma: 1/V times surface integral of integrated a^2*Fnu, outward positive

equations.threshold_rule: q0=a*nu0, so integrated above-threshold derivative includes -dot(q0)*Nq(q0)

equations.gate: shared physical edge uses one identical numerical flux
same event counted as exactly one photon loss and one HII creation

equations.upper_boundary: nu*Nnu -> 0; otherwise retain upper inflow explicitly

equations.requires: x=b throughout a time interval and externally supplied phase-density/front evolution
sharp x=b, fixed alpha and fixed phase electron factor chi_e

requires: no unaccounted other absorption or extra ionization
Case-B OTS with no explicit duplicate ground-recombination source

sharp_phase_admissibility.zero_filling_endpoint: QV=0 has undefined conditional deltaI; specify one-sided phase onset separately
sharp_phase_admissibility.derivative_evidence: An instantaneous binary cell sample does not determine geometric QV_dot. A helper solving F1 is an inventory conversion, not an independent front-law validation.

recombination_ownership_profiles.forbidden: subtracting a second identical export sink from the tracked sum

recombination_ownership_profiles.requires: one tracked ionizing photon per ground capture; excited ionizing tails neglected or separately counted; photon storage retained

recombination_ownership_profiles.forbidden: adding the same explicit ground-recombination source after eliminating it

assumptions: initial number spectrum and primary emission proportional to nu^-p with p>1
Case-A recombination radiation exported from tracked bath
controlled_history.spectral_condition: p>1 for finite photon number and vanishing upper number boundary; p>2 also gives finite photon energy, without claiming an energy solver
controlled_history.plot_label_if_later_executed: Controlled FLRW grey power-law Case-A primary-bath evolution

actual_E3_execution_scope.scope: Native photon adapter only; no coupled matter, photoabsorption or recombination history.
actual_E3_execution_scope.spectrum: p=3 power-law continued above the finite highest group boundary
actual_E3_execution_scope.upper_boundary: Nonzero redshift inflow from the explicitly supplied upper power-law tail; not a zero upper-boundary condition.
actual_E3_execution_scope.execution_statistics: Read the runtime evidence file; this theory contract does not replace that record.

implementation_acceptance.required: actual atomic-provider source-bound local H photo/recomb rates
implementation_acceptance.must_not: replace tested production consumer with a standalone formula-only test

implementation_acceptance.required: same H absorption event enters matter and photon ledgers with opposite signs
proper-to-comoving unit conversion explicit; reference cm^3 to cMpc^3 includes MPC_CM^3
threshold edge uses per-energy/per-frequency units consistently: H*E0*N_E(E0)=H*nu0*Nnu(nu0)
finite-cell averages use named XV and XM; externally supplied QV and QV_dot tagged as geometry inputs
negative mutants detect extra fraction dilution, missing threshold loss, duplicated recombination photons, and wrong volume/mass identity
Case-A F03 status and future F04 status remain separate; existing strict numerical gates remain unchanged
Filling helper evidence states conditional inventory conversion only, unless an independent moving-front/density law is actually executed
Any time-history result records its declared atomic ownership profile, spectral closure, ODE tolerances, and conservation residual separately from physical-fit claims

low_cost_llm_rules: Keep XV, XM and QV distinct.
Do not insert -3Hx in a fraction equation.
Do not drop moving-threshold redshift flux when using comoving frequency.
Do not derive a front velocity from a single binary snapshot.
Do not change Case-A to Case-B without declaring recycling ownership.
Do not equate theory identities with executed code tests.
Never promote a controlled E3 plot to a physical reionization history.
Use primary-paper definitions rather than guessing the meaning of a letter Q.
